narrative.scqa_md:
Empower Federal Credit Union is a $4.1B in assets credit union regulated by NCUA (NCUSO ID 3025) with 501 employees. A 8.5% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [EV--013, EV--007]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.1/5. The deepest capability gap is Customer-Centric Culture at 1.9/5 against a 3.0 peer median [EV--002]. Next is Model CI/CD & Controlled Promotion at 1.9/5 against a 2.5 peer median [EV--007].

Third is Idea Management at 2.0/5 against a 2.5 peer median [EV--006]. The issue register adds Range-style citation 'EV--001 through EV--008' in report — violates explicit enumeration requirement (high severity). The issue register adds Score clustering: 78.7% of P1 subcaps scored 1.5 (exceeds 60%). Driven by 148 inherited level 1.5 defaults…. The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [EV-CONN-001].

The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below. The question for Empower Federal Credit Union is whether to close Customer-Centric Culture first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Empower Federal Credit Union should lead with Twilio (82/100 fit) against Video Banking, then sequence Tableau behind it. Closing Customer-Centric Culture to the peer median alone is worth 1.1 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. The analyst's own priority framing: "G-007 — No public business-banking penetration metrics across 12K SEG companies — Priority 2 —, — SEG business-banking penetration rate…".
